ontario-core-french-g5-all-strands.documentTitle: Ontario Core French Grade 5 - Overall Expectations
ontario-core-french-g5-all-strands.documentVersion: The Ontario Curriculum, Grades 4–8: French as a Second Language (2013)

standards.summaryText: determine meaning in a variety of oral French texts, using a range of listening strategies
standards.officialOutcomeText: determine meaning in a variety of oral French texts, using a range of listening strategies

standards.summaryText: interpret messages accurately while interacting in French for a variety of purposes and with diverse audiences
standards.officialOutcomeText: interpret messages accurately while interacting in French for a variety of purposes and with diverse audiences

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of information in oral French texts about aspects of culture in diverse French-speaking communities and other communities around the world, and of French sociolinguistic conventions used in a variety of situations and communities
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of information in oral French texts about aspects of culture in diverse French-speaking communities and other communities around the world, and of French sociolinguistic conventions used in a variety of situations and communities

standards.summaryText: communicate information and ideas orally in French, using a variety of speaking strategies and age- and grade-appropriate language suited to the purpose and audience
standards.officialOutcomeText: communicate information and ideas orally in French, using a variety of speaking strategies and age- and grade-appropriate language suited to the purpose and audience

standards.summaryText: participate in spoken interactions in French for a variety of purposes and with diverse audiences
standards.officialOutcomeText: participate in spoken interactions in French for a variety of purposes and with diverse audiences

standards.summaryText: in their spoken communications, demonstrate an awareness of aspects of culture in diverse French-speaking communities and other communities around the world, and of the appropriate use of French sociolinguistic conventions in a variety of situations
standards.officialOutcomeText: in their spoken communications, demonstrate an awareness of aspects of culture in diverse French-speaking communities and other communities around the world, and of the appropriate use of French sociolinguistic conventions in a variety of situations

standards.summaryText: determine meaning in a variety of French texts, using a range of reading comprehension strategies
standards.officialOutcomeText: determine meaning in a variety of French texts, using a range of reading comprehension strategies

standards.summaryText: identify the purpose(s) and characteristics of a variety of adapted and authentic text forms, including fictional, informational, graphic, and media forms
standards.officialOutcomeText: identify the purpose(s) and characteristics of a variety of adapted and authentic text forms, including fictional, informational, graphic, and media forms

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of information in French texts about aspects of culture in diverse French-speaking communities and other communities around the world, and of French sociolinguistic conventions used in a variety of situations and communities
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of information in French texts about aspects of culture in diverse French-speaking communities and other communities around the world, and of French sociolinguistic conventions used in a variety of situations and communities

standards.summaryText: write French texts for different purposes and audiences, using a variety of forms
standards.officialOutcomeText: write French texts for different purposes and audiences, using a variety of forms

standards.summaryText: use the stages of the writing process – including pre-writing, producing drafts, revising, editing, and publishing – to develop and organize content, clarify ideas and expression, correct errors, and present their written work effectively
standards.officialOutcomeText: use the stages of the writing process – including pre-writing, producing drafts, revising, editing, and publishing – to develop and organize content, clarify ideas and expression, correct errors, and present their written work effectively

standards.summaryText: in their written work, demonstrate an awareness of aspects of culture in diverse French-speaking communities and other communities around the world, and of the appropriate use of French sociolinguistic conventions in a variety of situations
standards.officialOutcomeText: in their written work, demonstrate an awareness of aspects of culture in diverse French-speaking communities and other communities around the world, and of the appropriate use of French sociolinguistic conventions in a variety of situations
